name: Facet
text: Choose a dark theme by default with a one-click toggle to light mode. It reduces eye strain in low-light settings and keeps focus on the data, matching our competitive analysis of dark-themed dashboards like Manus. The trade-off is slightly lower readability for some users in bright environments, but the toggle mitigates that without cluttering the interface.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes don’t just bury errors—they hide them entirely when contrast drops below detection thresholds. A one-click toggle assumes users will switch when glare hits, but glare often comes in bursts (sun through blinds, phone flash), and the toggle itself adds cognitive friction. Settle it with a live contrast meter that auto-switches to light mode when ambient light exceeds a set threshold—no user action required.
